finding.observed_source_behavior: The previous strict ClayCode validator accepted mandatory bindings and omega validation gates by raw substring occurrence. Required text could therefore be placed inside string literals, and the validator did not establish that required calls were top-level executable statements.
finding.risk: A completion could receive structural/OOD credit without expressing the required runtime binding or deterministic omega admission sequence as actual ClayCode statements.
finding.repair: Count mandatory bindings, return, omega commit, omega gates, authority and generation only as standalone brace-depth-1 statements. Reject multiline/unclosed strings and comment syntax at this strict promotion boundary.

omega gate nested under control flow rejected
